title: Employee Expense Policy (2024, superseded)
text: Employee Expense Policy, revision 2024.1. Daily meal allowance is capped at 55 USD for domestic travel and 80 USD for international travel. Receipts are required for any single item above 25 USD.

title: Employee Expense Policy (2024, superseded)
text: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date. Reports submitted after 60 days require director approval and a written justification.

title: Employee Expense Policy (2026, current)
text: Employee Expense Policy, revision 2026.1. Daily meal allowance is capped at 70 USD for domestic travel and 95 USD for international travel. Receipts are required for any single item above 40 USD.

title: Employee Expense Policy (2026, current)
text: Expense reports must be submitted within 21 days of the expense date. Reports submitted after 45 days require director approval. Personal vehicle mileage is reimbursed at 0.67 USD per mile.

title: Employee Expense Policy (2026, current)
text: Alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances. Client entertainment requires pre-approval from a vice president and must be logged against a valid cost centre.

title: Corporate Travel Booking Standard
text: All flights must be booked through the corporate travel portal at least 14 days before departure. Economy class is mandatory for flights under six hours of scheduled flying time.

title: Corporate Travel Booking Standard
text: Business class is permitted only for flights exceeding eight hours, and requires approval from a senior director recorded in the travel portal before ticketing.

title: Access Control Standard
text: Privileged access to production systems is granted just-in-time for a maximum of four hours per elevation request. Standing administrator accounts are prohibited in production environments.

title: Access Control Standard
text: Access reviews run quarterly. Any account inactive for 45 consecutive days is automatically disabled, and inactive for 90 days is deleted along with its credentials.

title: Runbook: userauth service 5xx
text: Error code AUTH-5031 indicates the token introspection endpoint returned a non-200 response. The most common cause is an expired client secret in the OIDC provider configuration.

title: Runbook: userauth service 5xx
text: To resolve AUTH-5031, rotate the client secret in Secrets Manager, then restart the ECS service so the new secret is loaded. Confirm recovery via the /q/health/ready endpoint.

title: Runbook: userauth service 5xx
text: Error code AUTH-5044 is distinct: it means the downstream policy service timed out. Do not rotate secrets for AUTH-5044; check policy service latency dashboards instead.

title: Public API Gateway v2 Limits
text: The v2 gateway enforces 1000 requests per minute per API key. Requests beyond the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header indicating the number of seconds to wait.

title: Public API Gateway v2 Limits
text: Burst capacity allows 50 requests per second for up to 10 seconds. Partner tier keys are provisioned at 5000 requests per minute and are exempt from burst throttling.

title: Parental Leave Guidelines
text: Birthing parents receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Non-birthing parents and adoptive parents receive 12 weeks of fully paid leave within the first year.

title: Parental Leave Guidelines
text: Parental leave may be taken in up to three separate blocks. Requests must be filed at least 30 days in advance except in cases of medical emergency.

title: Invoice Approval Thresholds
text: Invoices under 5000 USD are approved by the cost centre owner. Invoices from 5000 to 50000 USD require finance business partner approval in addition to the cost centre owner.

title: Invoice Approval Thresholds
text: Invoices above 50000 USD require chief financial officer sign-off and a competitive bid record. Payment terms default to net 45 unless the contract specifies otherwise.

title: Data Retention Schedule
text: Customer transaction records are retained for seven years. Application logs containing personal data are retained for 90 days and then irreversibly deleted.

title: Data Retention Schedule
text: Deletion requests under GDPR article 17 must be completed within 30 calendar days. Backups are excluded from immediate deletion but expire on the standard 35 day backup cycle.

title: Laptop Provisioning Guide
text: New joiners receive a standard laptop configured by endpoint management. Engineering roles may request the high specification model with 64 GB of memory through the IT portal.

title: Laptop Provisioning Guide
text: Hardware refresh occurs every 36 months. Damaged devices are replaced within two business days at any staffed office location, subject to stock availability.

title: Encryption Standard
text: Data at rest must use AES-256. Data in transit must use TLS 1.2 or higher; TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are prohibited on all externally reachable listeners.

title: Encryption Standard
text: Key rotation is mandatory every 365 days for customer managed keys. Rotation events are recorded in the audit log and reviewed during the quarterly access review.
